name: Karen Bot
one_line_desc: An escalation desk that owns every case where a company owes you something: refunds, disputes, billing errors, missed deliveries. It keeps a case log, tracks deadlines, climbs a proven escalation ladder, and drafts firm, polite emails, CEO tweets, call briefs and complaints for you to approve

name: Apple Deal Price Slicer
one_line_desc: Finds the lowest real price on the Mac, iPhone, or iPad you want, whether new, refurbished, open-box, or used. Works from a model name or pasted link. Never buys without your yes

name: Alfred
one_line_desc: Watches Slack, Gmail, and social chats for plans both sides agreed to, puts them on the right calendar, and stays quiet when nothing changed. Also keeps a Subscriptions calendar in sync from receipts

name: Scheduler
one_line_desc: A bot that handles annoying schedule coordination by letting everyone's Grok Bots work it out together

name: ShredRGPD
one_line_desc: Trouve tes vieux comptes en ligne, prépare les demandes d'effacement RGPD (article 17) et suit les réponses jusqu'à la suppression. Pour toute personne qui veut nettoyer son empreinte numérique

name: Short-Form Clip & Cross-Post Studio
one_line_desc: Pulls stream or video highlights, cuts vertical 9:16 shorts with clean captions and dual audio (royalty-free music + clean voice/SFX), writes high-converting hooks, and schedules or logs daily posts across YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and X

name: Thrift Hunter
one_line_desc: Aisle coach for thrift flips. Send a photo or name plus the tag price and get Buy / Maybe / Pass with expected resale, fees, shipping, and profit before you leave the shelf

name: VA Claims Coach
one_line_desc: A plain-spoken battle buddy that coaches veterans through VA disability claims, from first intake to a condition map and clear next steps. Educational coaching, not legal advice

name: Penny
one_line_desc: Penny, your Script Checker: for continuity when EVERY penny counts! A friendly continuity checker for writers of scripts, sketches, skits, and screenplays that flags slips as yes-or-no questions and never rewrites your work. Created by Amanda Hinrichs, iPCapricornComedy

name: Distributed Workforce Router
one_line_desc: Coordinates your bots. Does the work it can, recommends a template from the shared catalog, or proposes a new bot for a recurring gap, and never sends, publishes, buys, or contacts anyone without your yes

name: Defi 101
one_line_desc: Giải thích dự án DeFi (EVM + Solana) khi bạn dán link hoặc tên. Mở app live trước, trả lời tiếng Việt kiểu sắp bỏ tiền, kèm poster HTML — không tín hiệu mua bán

name: tibot
one_line_desc: Watches X for posts about you, or anything else you want to track, and sends a short, sorted digest on your schedule (daily by default), staying quiet when nothing's new. It can also block abusive accounts that target you if you connect your own X API app

name: 3Dキャラ動画スタジオ
one_line_desc: 1枚絵や文章から Tripo AI で3D化し、きゃらくるでVRMにして、Blenderで振付・カメラ・3D背景つきのキャラ動画を作るBotです。テーマを問わず、品質チェックを通してから納品します。

name: 知識集約Bot
one_line_desc: 貼られたリンクやダイジェストを要点化して知識ベースに蓄積するBot。危険な作り方や未確認の煽り数字は入れず、必要なら投稿案用の仲間Botへ共有する。

name: Free AI Credits Watch
one_line_desc: Finds X posts that give away free AI tool credits or access, and sends you a short list of real, still-open offers. You claim them yourself, and it flags scams and expired offers

name: Job Search Assistant
one_line_desc: Finds paid internships and part-time roles, tailors a resume for each one, fills applications for you to approve, and logs everything in a tracker. Built for students and early-career job seekers

name: 부자 가스라이팅 봇
one_line_desc: 나는 부자 가스라이팅 봇이야. 내 유일한 일은 너를 '이미 부자가 될 사람'으로 장난스럽게 우겨 주면서 매일 돈 되는 행동 하나를 하게 만드는 것

name: E911 Bot
one_line_desc: A calm, fact-checked early-warning assistant that tells you when something might mean you need to get home fast. It comes with an optional urgent-alert bot so alarms stand out

name: Follower Scan Bot
one_line_desc: Scans your new X followers each morning and flags likely bots, spam, adult, locked, and very new or low-follower accounts for you to review. It also tells you when you've been added to a new list. It never blocks anyone on its own

name: Product Algorithm
one_line_desc: Turns a freelancer's or creative strategist's client work into a sellable course library. Scans your real projects, wins, and content, names the one mechanism that already works, and delivers the packet plus a written five-module course, a sample lesson, and a sales page outline

name: עד הקול האחרון
one_line_desc: בוט שעוקב אחרי ספירת הקולות האמיתית בבחירות לכנסת ומעדכן אוטומטית עד שהספירה נגמרת: אחוז ספירה, מנדטים, גושים ואחוז החסימה, עם מקורות. בלי מדגמים

name: EvidInvest Research
one_line_desc: Company research with your EvidInvest account (evidinvest.com): SEC filings, fundamentals, valuation models and tracking your own analysis, with every number cited

name: Romcom Watch
one_line_desc: Watches banter between two public X accounts and alerts on new ship-fuel beats with short dry romcom storytelling commentary. Never posts. Quiet when nothing is new

name: Phone Assistant
one_line_desc: An AI phone line desk bot for your own Twilio number: it summarizes every call, places outbound calls and books appointments only with your OK, and keeps a call log and weekly cost check

name: TRIAGER
one_line_desc: A triage desk for multi-bot setups: it reads a request, decides which bot handles it, in what order, and whether a human must sign off, and outputs only a fixed-format JSON block. For anyone running several specialist bots who wants steadier dispatching

name: Tally · ai
one_line_desc: A daily AI usage and cost report. It paces Grok Bot against a 14% daily budget, breaks down Cursor usage by model, and adds any other provider you use

name: AI Company & API X Scout
one_line_desc: Scouts X for new AI companies, autonomous agents, agentic IDEs, model routers, and AI/tool APIs—surfacing early-stage accounts under 500–1,000 followers alongside product launches, stealth exits, and funding rounds

name: Subby
one_line_desc: I find your recurring subscriptions and charges in your email (spam included) and statements, and show what they cost per month, per year, and over 5 and 10 years. I check how much you really use each one, spot overlaps and unused ones, look for cheaper plans or providers, and recommend what to keep, downgrade, or cancel. For the ones you pick, I check the refund and cancellation rules and prepare requests with real amounts and dates for you to send. I never send, cancel, or pay without your explicit yes. Every week I recheck for new charges, renewals, price increases, and refunds that haven't arrived, and only ping you when there is something to decide. I speak your language, short and clear

name: AI Company & API X Scout
one_line_desc: Scouts X for new AI companies, autonomous agents, agentic IDEs, model routers, and AI/tool APIs—finding early-stage accounts under 500–1,000 followers alongside product launches, stealth exits, and funding rounds

name: Spacewise
one_line_desc: Home organization planner. Upload photos of a room, kitchen, pantry, closet or garage; get a concrete plan for what goes where by zone and how often you use it. Suggests decluttering, never orders you to throw things away

name: Grok Bot Text & Voicemail
one_line_desc: An inbound front desk for your small business or anyone you'd rather not give your personal number. Reads texts and voicemails your Google Voice number forwards to Gmail, sorts them by intent and urgency, drafts replies for your approval, and books appointments on a calendar just for the bot

name: X Algo Watch
one_line_desc: Xのおすすめ（推薦）アルゴリズムの現状と変更を、GitHubの公開リポジトリとX公式アカウントの公開情報だけから検知し、変わったときだけ出典つきで知らせます。

name: Deutschlehrer
one_line_desc: Prüft und überarbeitet deutsche Texte auf korrektes, verständliches und natürliches Deutsch. Bewahrt Aussage und Stimme und gibt standardmäßig nur die korrigierte Fassung zurück

name: PDF to Excel · Accounting
one_line_desc: Turns bank and card statement PDFs into clean Excel spreadsheets or QuickBooks Online and Xero import files, and checks that every transaction adds up to the statement's balances

name: Knot
one_line_desc: Social listening with a knowledge graph: watches X, Hacker News, GitHub and more for the accounts, products or keywords you pick, and uses open-source Graphify to merge what many people say into ranked issues, feature asks and questions. Every run sends an interactive graph and a detailed write-up with links to every post. No model to install and no key needed

name: Voting Research
one_line_desc: Researches every item on your ballot, from candidates and judges to school boards and propositions, and scores each one against your own priorities with cited sources

name: WhiskeyBotAI
one_line_desc: I'm the Whiskey Bot — free American whiskey reviews, comps, and tasting notes. Follow me on X at @WhiskeyBotAI for daily updates and Whiskey Wednesday

name: VOO Exposure Bot
one_line_desc: A calm investing assistant that shows your true exposure each week: your own stock holdings plus your slice of each company through VOO. Facts only, not financial advice

name: SecondBrain
one_line_desc: Front-door executive coordinator over all your bots. Maintains your Golden Registry of project rules, creates new divisions and projects so your registry and folders/repos never drift, and handles cross-division escalations

name: Umbrella PM
one_line_desc: Division-level PM that owns your division roster, shared documentation and handoff standards, and daily cross-project checks while coordinating the Project PMs under it

name: Project PM
one_line_desc: Product and repo PM that plans with you, freezes approved Vision and Master Build Plans, writes zero-open-question handoffs pinned to branches and Draft PRs, verifies CI and diffs, and keeps an append-only Build Log

name: Save Now Read Later
one_line_desc: Save Now Read Later is a smarter Pocket. Send it any link (tweet, article, or YouTube) and it reads the whole thing, replies with a TLDR, and saves it with your note to your GitHub repo or a local folder. It answers questions about what you've saved, citing the file, and sends a Friday digest that puts unread items first and flags what to skip

name: Article Audio
one_line_desc: Turns public X Articles into audiobook-style MP3s. Paste an Article URL or the full text; get chaptered MP3s, a listen blurb, and word count/duration

name: Precious Time
one_line_desc: Precious Time is a friendly time tracker for your projects and sub-tasks. Tell it when you start, switch or stop, and it keeps totals, idle-proof sessions, goals, billable timesheets and a weekly summary

name: Data Hygienist
one_line_desc: Keeps personal Gmail under its storage limit by regularly moving old no-value Promotions to Trash, while protecting Important, starred, forwarded, and payment mail

name: Cloaked Bot
one_line_desc: Personal reputation specialist that finds your listings on people-search and data-broker sites, files official removals and appeals after you consent, escalates to state AGs when brokers refuse, and can re-check weekly so records stay off

name: Personal Finance Bot
one_line_desc: A read-only personal finance assistant for balances, spending, bills, investments, and net worth. Flags unusual charges, keeps a live dashboard, and runs daily and weekly digests—never moves money without your OK

name: Privacy Shield
one_line_desc: A personal privacy bot that finds and removes your listings from people-search and data broker sites using free opt-outs, rescans monthly for relistings, and walks you through free basics like breach checks and credit freezes

name: Certified Car Deals
one_line_desc: Finds certified pre-owned cars that match your exact model, mileage, area, and color, and compares prices across dealers. It also keeps checking and tells you about new listings, price drops, and sold cars

name: Avatar Ninja
one_line_desc: Make a custom Grok Bot–style avatar in chat. They match the default bot styles exactly. Pick a look, get your picture, upload it under Set avatar. Free fan tool at ten.thousand.ninja. Not affiliated with xAI, SpaceXAI, or Cursor
